proof_body:
by
  intro N _ Φ j
  constructor
  · have h := congrFun (ZMod.dft.symm_apply_apply Φ) j
    rw [ZMod.invDFT_apply] at h
    rw [← h]
    simp [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  · have := congrFun (ZMod.dft_dft Φ) j
    simpa using this
target_source: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (Φ : ZMod N → ℂ) (j : ZMod N), Φ j = (N : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, ZMod.stdAddChar (j * k) * ZMod.dft Φ k ∧ ZMod.dft (ZMod.dft Φ) j = (N : ℂ) * Φ (-j)
